messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your concern. Since the previous steps haven't resolved it, the next step is to reset your APN settings to the carrier defaults. This will refresh the MMS server settings (including the MMSC URL).

Please run this action on your phone:
- **reset_apn_settings**

After that completes, you must restart your phone for the changes to apply:
- **reboot_device**

Once your phone has restarted, try sending an MMS again (or run **can_send_mms** again) and tell me the result. Your photos and data will be safe—this only resets network settings.

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone as you instructed. Unfortunately, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should we do next? I'm really getting frustrated now.

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
